scripts.dev: pnpm --filter=@gym/shared build && concurrently "pnpm --filter=@gym/shared dev" "PORT=3001 pnpm --filter=auth-service dev" "PORT=3002 pnpm --filter=client-service dev" "PORT=3003 pnpm --filter=membership-service dev" "PORT=3004 pnpm --filter=payment-service dev" "PORT=3000 pnpm --filter=api-gateway dev" "pnpm --filter=frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter=@gym/shared build && pnpm --filter='./services/*' build && pnpm --filter=frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter=@gym/shared lint && pnpm --filter='./services/*' lint && pnpm --filter=frontend lint
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter=@gym/shared test && pnpm --filter='./services/*' test && pnpm --filter=frontend test
scripts.docker:dev: pnpm build && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f compose.yaml -f compose.local.yaml up -d --no-build --remove-orphans && docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f compose.yaml -f compose.local.yaml restart auth-service client-service membership-service payment-service api-gateway frontend
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter=@gym/shared exec rm -rf dist && pnpm --filter='./services/*' exec rm -rf dist && pnpm --filter=frontend exec rm -rf dist
